d:
Patakhon se hone vale is janleva pradushan aur svasthy suraksha ko lekar sena ke purv kamandent aur varishth chikitsak do. sanjay kumar ne aam janta ko vishesh savdhani baratne ki salah di hai. unhonne spasht kiya ki patakhon ka dhuaan garbh men pal rahe bachchon, navjaton aur kamjor imyuniti vale bujurgon ke phephron ko sabse jyada nuksan pahunchata hai. vayu pradushan ke is daur men doktaron ki ray manna har nagrik ke lie behad jaruri hai.
